paragraphs: Yose bar Ashyan: Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah, chapter 4, halakhah 6; Rav Yitzchak bar Ashyan: Berakhot 14a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The title before Yitzchak is abbreviated ר׳ in the supplied notice. The William Davidson digital text of Berakhot 14a fully writes Rav Yitzchak bar Ashyan (רב יצחק בר אשיאן), supporting Rav here; the heading’s Ashyan spelling is retained.

The actual Davidson Berakhot 14a explicitly names Rav Yitzchak bar Ashyan. Hyman’s אשיין and the digital אשיאן remain distinct. The separate untitled Yose pointer and supplied Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah locator are retained without a fresh collation of that occurrence. The current note remains verbatim.
